_meta.presentationSummary: Coins named for DacityCoin and AudaCity, a fictional crypto brand that posts say appears in Grand Theft Auto VI. On 2026-10-11 the account @robtmb1 posted that a GTA 6 leak shows a meme coin called "Dacity Coin"; the first Dacity Coin on Pump.fun was created 35 seconds later. Posts since Rockstar's 2026-11-10 pre-load trailer say AudaCity boxes, a billboard and DacityCoin appear in its footage. On 2026-11-18, the day before the release, posts say a streamer with early access showed $DCTY as DacityCoin's ticker in the game, and a recap says $DacityCoin fell from $7m to under $1m while a rumour that the ticker was $DCI was fake; others argue the lore-correct ticker is still $DacityCoin. The most-traded DCTY coin moved over 50x in 24h and is quarantined, so it is not a member. Sixteen coins are members, seven of them collected. Collected, all on Solana: on Pump.fun, Dacity Coin (token created 2026-10-11), AudaCity (symbol DacityCoin) and DacityCoin (2026-10-15), DacityCoin with the symbol DACITY (2026-10-15), DTC (2026-10-20), DAC (2026-10-24), two DacityCoin coins with the symbol DCI (pools opened 2026-11-12 and 2026-11-13), and, from 2026-11-19, AudaCity ("Crypto Metaverse/App/Platform of GTA6", pool opened 2026-11-18) and DacityCoin with the symbol DCTC (2026-11-19). Archived (under $1,000 on two consecutive observations; memberships stay open): two GTAVI AudaCity coins on Pump.fun, Dacity Coin on pons (Robinhood Chain) and three Meteora DBC AudaCity copies, and, on 2026-11-22, DTC, DacityCoin (DACITY) and the DCI coin at 85EzCV... Most have empty descriptions, so their names carry the claim. What the game shows was not checked here, the ticker claims are unverified, and none of the coins is shown to be affiliated with Rockstar or Take-Two.
